summary: Written by the data agent at build time, pending a real judge. Every top 10 film is a household name, but the sequels beat the classics: Up is #11, Monsters, Inc. #16, the first Toy Story #21.
reasons: Casual found Finding Nemo, Inside Out 2, Incredibles 2, Coco, Toy Story 4 and Inside Out, and lost lives on the first Toy Story and The Incredibles (both offered with their sequels, confirmed as typed), Up, Monsters, Inc. and Cars. Typing the sequels first finds 8 or 9.
Every Pixar feature is an answer with its gross, so every miss shows a figure; other studios' films (Frozen, Shrek, Minions, Zootopia, Planes) and announced sequels (Incredibles 3, Coco 2) are free.
